obligations.statement: The stand must be compact, i.e., folded size minimized.
derivation_premises: A compact product requires smaller outer dimensions when folded.

obligations.statement: The stand must have exactly three legs that fold close to the body.
derivation_premises: The number of legs is fixed by the requirement.

obligations.statement: Folding must be possible without detaching any part.
derivation_premises: Permanent attachment allows folding without detachment.

obligations.statement: A user must be able to open the stand by hand without tools.
derivation_premises: Hand manipulation implies the user can apply forces to the stand.

obligations.statement: When open, the three legs must be spread apart in different directions.
derivation_premises: Different directions are needed for a usable footprint.

obligations.statement: The stand must remain open without user support.
derivation_premises: An open configuration must be stable under its own weight and any disturbance.

obligations.statement: No unintended movement of any component when the stand is in use.
derivation_premises: Unintended movement would violate the requirement.

obligations.statement: Folding must require a deliberate user action.
derivation_premises: A deliberate action implies the open configuration is stable and requires an explicit input to change.

obligations.statement: The stand must support a small object.
derivation_premises: Supporting a load requires the structure to withstand the load without excessive deflection.

obligations.statement: The stand must be repeatedly openable and foldable without part detachment.
derivation_premises: Repeatability implies no irreversible changes or part loss.

obligations.statement: The stand must be manufactured and assembled in a sensible order.
derivation_premises: A product must be assemblable with a logical sequence.

candidates.summary: A stand using revolute joints for the three legs, with a detent or snap to hold open and a release mechanism.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Primary function of leg motion can be analyzed for degrees of freedom.

candidates.summary: A stand using compliant flexures for leg motion, with an over-center toggle to hold open.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Compliant mechanisms allow motion; load capacity may require stress analysis.

candidates.summary: A stand using a prismatic pair for a sliding leg and revolute pairs for others, with a friction hold.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Friction hold may require analysis of forces.
